description: Pre-payment check: can this payment from source to destination succeed now? When to use: Right before sending a payment: to catch a missing or unfunded destination, a required destination tag, deposit authorization, missing or frozen trust lines, insufficient balance and issuer freezes, in one call. Prefer another tool: To find a multi-hop route or the source amount needed for a cross-currency payment (use the paths endpoint), or to list balances (use `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/summary`). Example: xrpl_payment_readiness {"source":"rHb9CJAWyB4rj91VRWn96DkukG4bwdtyTh","destination":"rvYAfWj5gh67oV6fW32ZzP3Aw4Eubs59B"}

amount.description: Positive decimal amount of asset; omit to skip amount-dependent checks

asset.description: XRP (default) or CODE.issuer (3-character or 40-hex code, classic issuer)

destination.description: Receiving account: valid classic XRPL address, different from source

destination_tag.description: Destination tag you will send: an integer from 0 to 4294967295

source.description: Sending account: valid classic XRPL address (r..., checksum verified)

name: xrpl_payment_readiness

age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from the ledger

ledger_index.description: Validated ledger the data comes from

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

amount.description: Amount checked; null when omitted (amount checks skipped)

spendable_xrp.description: Source XRP above its live reserve and the standard fee; null when not computable

transfer_fee_pct.description: Issuer transfer fee in percent, when it applies

verdict.description: `not_ready` on any blocking reason; else `unknown` on any failed sub-check

title: Payment readiness
